analytic.measure_differs: Open CASCADE's prism takes the lateral area of an arc as its 2D perimeter times length (140 pi * 10 here), the area of a right cylinder; the oblique cylinder's is the perimeter of its section perpendicular to the direction, an ellipse of eccentricity 0.6, times the length, 280 E(0.6). Open CASCADE's area is 1371.770 against 1329.010, 3.2% high; volume, centroid and counts agree. The fault is in its measurement, not its shape
